name: Hnúšťa (Slovakia)
description: Four equal horizontal stripes of yellow, blue, white and red, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature H-4/1991.
